result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with integrated streetcar tracks and overhead wires. While there are marked crosswalks and traffic signals, the large crossing distances and lack of pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and streetcar tracks without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style markings for better visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a complex intersection with multiple travel lanes, trolley tracks, and a lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks are present, the wide turning radii and absence of visible crosswalks or pedestrian signals create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected path across the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center intersection area

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slipping hazard for cyclists, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The geometry of the intersection allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the red building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The environment is a complex urban intersection featuring multiple travel lanes, trolley tracks, and significant overhead wiring.
